name: How long does a freestanding tub installation typically take?
description: Installation time varies, from one to two days for simple cases to several days if plumbing or floor modifications are needed.

mainEntity.name: How long does a freestanding tub installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a freestanding tub installation varies based on the complexity of the project. A straightforward replacement might take one to two days. However, if plumbing needs to be relocated, or the floor requires reinforcement, the process can extend to several days. We provide a detailed project timeline after an initial site assessment in areas such as Dublin or Emeryville.
